_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31), read by nothing yet. Camp-life and winter quests, same shape as data/items/starter_goals.json (see its _about for check kinds) with two additions: `needs_code` (true when a check kind or item chain does not exist yet: sea salt, new events worn_warmth, talked, moved_lit_night) and `after` may name goals from starter_goals.json. They teach the winter chain: render fat, smoke fish, dry berries, salt meat, keep a store, dress for the cold. The drying rack is not a structure yet (campfire does the drying in the recipes); jerky and salted fish need sea salt (WATER_GATHER_SPEC.md).

goals.title: Light the night
goals.hint: Craft a Basic torch from a stick and 2 fibre, and carry it after dark.

goals.title: Work by candlelight
goals.hint: Render fat into tallow, then make candles to light your shelter.

goals.title: Smoke a fish
goals.hint: Catch a fish and smoke it with samphire and juniper berries at the campfire.

goals.title: Dry berries for winter
goals.hint: Dry blueberries by the fire so they keep.

goals.title: Make jerky
goals.hint: Salt strips of meat and dry them. Needs sea salt.

goals.title: Salt a fish
goals.hint: Cure a fish in salt for the winter store. Needs sea salt.

goals.title: Fill your winter store
goals.hint: Hold 5 foods that keep: smoked fish, jerky, dried berries, salted fish, trail bread.

goals.title: Dress for the cold
goals.hint: Wear a full hide set or better before winter.

goals.title: Hear a story at the fire
goals.hint: Sit by the fire at night with Edda or Hob and listen.

goals.title: Cross the camp at night with a torch
goals.hint: Walk 100 m with a lit torch after dark without stumbling.
